releases.name: Revenant : In Memory Of The Day
releases.summary: You are heading down an endless corridor in search of a missing child. Pay close attention to your surroundings to find clues about the child, and find a way to escape the dark, confined corridor.

releases.name: K-POP Rising: Dream to Shine
releases.summary: In K-POP Rising: Dream to Shine, players immerse themselves in the demanding and fascinating world of modern music. Accompanied by their best friend Nova, they will need to commit 100 percent to the race for stardom: from intensive training sessions in the studio to the ultimate recognition on the most prestigious stages, the title offers a complete experience combining a sense of rhythm, deep customization, and community management in the era of social media.

releases.name: Yomawari: The Long Night Collection
releases.summary: Twice the fright. Traverse the haunting world of Yomawari: Night Alone as a young girl searches for her sister, then share in the terror facing schoolgirls Yui and Haru in Yomawari: Midnight Shadows. Uncover the mysteries plaguing a rural Japanese town, hide from the things lurking in the night, and maybe get home alive.

releases.name: Dark Alley
releases.summary:
Kyoto, 2013. A British detective vanishes without a trace. London sends Thomas Bennett to close the case quietly. But Kyoto doesn’t do “quiet.” Beneath red lanterns and rain-slicked alleys, Bennett finds a city built on rituals, secrets... and people willing to kill to protect them.

What starts as a missing-person investigation spirals into a dangerous web involving the Dragon Vein Yakuza, a mysterious informant, and a cold institutional presence that watches every step Bennett takes. The deeper you go through nightclubs, temples, bamboo forests and mirrored corridors, the more mystery arise around the case... until the question isn’t who took Hale, but why the truth was never meant to survive.

Dark Alley is a standalone case within the Detective Bennett: Solved Cases saga, a cinematic narrative thriller with psychological tension and dry, noir humor.

releases.name: Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School
releases.summary:
Welcome to Escape Academy, the world’s foremost clandestine educator in the art of Escape. Whether you’re a returning student or a new pupil, you’ve come to the right place. 

Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School evolves the escape room format of the first game into a whole new GENRE: This is the first open world escape room game, and it's available right in the comfort of your own home.

In Escape Academy 2, the campus is one big puzzle room. Between classes, explore a sprawling, secret-filled hub with mysterious passage ways, hidden tunnels, and dangerous traps. Or chill out with your pals and take in all the vibes that student life has to offer.

releases.name: Yomawari: Lost in the Dark
releases.summary:
To break a curse placed upon her, a young girl must venture into the haunted streets of her town at night to search for her lost memories while evading
the twisted spirits that lurk in the darkness.

releases.name: CRYMELIGHT
releases.summary: CRYMELIGHT is a roguelike action game set in the world of the afterlife, where girls confront their sins as they fight to gain their freedom.

releases.name: Kingdom of Night
releases.summary: Hunt down nightmarish demons and save the town of Miami, AZ in this 80s-themed, isometric action-RPG. With an expansive, interconnected map and open-ended quests, explore freely while unraveling the main story. Kingdom of Night is a unique blend of coming-of-age drama, cosmic horror, and true love.

releases.name: Exzisus
releases.summary:
"EXZISUS" is a shooting game released by TAITO in 1987.
Control Cosmo Fighter Robin and defeat the mysterious army infesting the 4th Galaxy using your blaster and missiles.
Each item collected powers Robin up, allowing it to transform into Turbo Jet mode or summon bird and dog animal robots to support you in attack.
Aim for the weak parts of the giant robots waiting at the end of each stage.

releases.name: Faraway
releases.summary: You are a shooting star that refuses its fate of disappearing in the ether, to instead go travel space and draw constellations through its journey. Faraway is a one-button game, with a simple set of rules finely balanced to adapt to different playing levels, within an always renewed universe that is procedurally generated in real time - based on score -, resulting in an infinitely replayable game. Like Steph Thirion's first game Eliss, Faraway is set in a bizarre and lonely outer space, was 100% created - design, coding, music and sound - by one person, and all its graphics are drawn by code, resulting in a rarely personal sensory experience.

releases.name: Dominus Gladiatus
releases.summary: Build your Ludus. Train gladiators. Fight for glory. Dominus Gladiatus is a brutal gladiator management simulator where you recruit, train and equip gladiators before sending them into the arenas of ancient Rome.

releases.name: House Builder 2
releases.summary: In House Builder 2, you build your dream structures in a vibrant, open-world low-poly environment! Purchase materials for your work, load them up, and head off to diverse tasks in the ultimate building adventure!

releases.name: Hypermarket: Sort & Stock
releases.summary: A large-scale sorting simulator set in a two-storey hypermarket: organize 65,146 products and boxes across 23 departments, stock shelves and warehouse racks, and use boosters to find, carry and place items.

releases.name: Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE
releases.summary:
Solo Leveling, the webtoon with 14.3 billion views worldwide, is now an action RPG game!

Become the Monarch of Shadows through intense solo combat and 4-player co-op raids!

From the pages of the webtoon to your screen, bring the story to life in Solo Leveling:ARISE OVERDRIVE!

releases.name: Worship
releases.summary: Incite the end of the world as a devout zealot of an eldritch god in this multiplayer Pikmin-inspired roguelite. Don the robes of a cultist, perform bloody rituals and expand your influence over an army of followers in this cute yet grim world. Is your devotion strong enough to please the Old Ones?

releases.name: Outbreak: Dead City
releases.summary: Survive as a soldier sent to suppress the zombie threat and find a vaccine to save humanity! Outbreak: Dead City is a cinematic narrative first-person shooter presented in low-poly 3D style.

releases.name: VOID/BREAKER
releases.summary:
You are trapped in an endless sequence by the all-seeing, hostile AI. You are its prisoner - forced to fight, die, and repeat.

The machines think you'll never escape. The system is designed to keep you here.

Adrenaline-Fueled Roguelite FPS. Fight relentless machines driven by a hostile AI. Escape an endless cycle. Craft infinite weapon variants with deep gun modding. Forge deadly synergies. Carve your way out through enviro destruction 

/BREAK THE SYSTEM /BREAK THE SEQUENCE /BREAK FREE

releases.name: We are Eva
releases.summary:
Are you reading this? Hi! My name is Eva. I'm the main protagonist of the game you're looking at. Yes, this little platformer game is about me... About me AND dimensional travel! Do you want to know more?

Okay, well... I am a (mostly) peaceful creature living between different worlds. Sleeping is usually all I do, but right now, something evil is happening to said worlds, and I want it to stop. That's where I need you, for your ability to see in 2D... There's no time to explain!!!

Play the game in multiple dimensions simultaneously, traveling through them at will!

Each level changes whenever you fail! Say "yes!" to an ever-fresh experience!

releases.name: Tom Clancy's The Division 2: Echoes of Central Park
releases.summary:
This single-player or online co-op experience includes:
- A level 40 boost that allows you to jump right into the Echoes of Central Park campaign
- 50 stash space increase, allowing you to store more gear

EXPLORE CENTRAL PARK FOR THE FIRST TIME
Overgrown and reclaimed by nature, Central Park and the surrounding streets of Upper West Side are presented like never before. Haunted by fear and sinister tales, the park has become home to a new apex threat that lurks in its shadows. You must confront this formidable force, as well as familiar foes with their own agendas, to uncover what happened inside the park.

FIGHT ALONGSIDE UNIQUE COMPANIONS
As the Division’s mission is halted by a sinister threat, you must rely on three reluctant heroes to guide you through the park. Each brings a distinct past and fighting style, ranging from a former Division agent to a battle-hardened athlete.

UNLOCK A NEW ENDGAME EXPERIENCE
Ambushed and pressured by unknown ravagers, you first enter the park fighting to survive. Once the story is complete, the balance of power shifts, allowing you to return to Central Park and dictate the fight, pursue enemies on your own terms, and tackle new challenges to earn exclusive and valuable rewards.

EXPAND YOUR SKILLS AND GEAR
By defeating Central Park’s primary threats and their twisted abilities, you can earn new powers of your own. Six new skill variants grant beast‑like skills inspired by the horrors you’ll overcome. New gear is also introduced, including a brand-new Exotic Weapon, a new gear set, and more.

releases.name: Pit of Goblin
releases.summary: In this online horror co-op, you play as a scrappy goblin, scavenging dungeons, dodging traps, and fleeing monsters to feed the Goblin King. Team up with goblin pals, or go rogue, as you dive deep and cause chaos! Fail to feed him, and you might be the next meal!

releases.name: Bowling Alley Simulator
releases.summary: Bowling Alley Simulator lets you build, manage, and grow your own bowling alley. Run the lanes, cook classic food, hire staff, and expand your business into a thriving entertainment destination.

releases.name: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered
releases.summary:
The ultimate kaiju arena brawler is back, completely remastered. From Atari and original developer, Pipeworks, Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered updates the 2002 fighter with enhanced visuals and quality of life improvements. 

Choose your monster and battle it out with a range of brutal attacks through 8 locations, each with day and night variations. Battle through real-world cities, Monster Island, and the alien Mothership. Face off against your friends in local co-op or new online multiplayer.

Master your skills in cinematic kaiju vs. kaiju battles through familiar cities. Every monster has a distinctive moveset that makes each brawl unique, from vicious melee attacks to ranged energy blasts to special Rage Mode strikes. Tired of throwing punches? Why not throw a skyscraper, instead? The arenas are not just passive locations, and instead allow you to use the environment strategically in combat and even weaponize buildings and other landmarks.

releases.name: ZERO PARADES: Director's Cut
releases.summary:
Brilliant, burnt-out, possibly cursed – you play as operant Hershel Wilk, alias CASCADE. Five years ago you led your team into the abyss and have been haunted by your failures ever since. Now you've been recalled for a mysterious assignment that may give you a chance to prove yourself again.

Find yourself thrown into a three-way struggle for cultural and ideological power, played out across an unforgettable new city. In ZERO PARADES, the world itself is a character with its own secrets, traumas, and miracles for you to discover.

To get anywhere in this world, you'll need friends. Unfortunately, you don't have any. Instead, you'll go up against international bankers, foreign techno-fascists, psychic doppelgängers, a paranoid TV presenter, a man with a box for a heart, and dozens more. Everyone you meet has their own agendas, beliefs, and secrets for you to uncover and turn to your own ends.

releases.name: Cat President 2: Purrlitical Revolution
releases.summary:
The cats are back to win your heart -- and your vote!

In a world where talking cats control the U.S. government, President DJ Nibbles is running for re-election -- and you've been hired to stop him at all costs. Who cares that you're a random ride-share driver who didn't even know an election was happening? That doesn't mean you can't run the purrfect campaign!

Can you handle the world of Presidential politics? Do you even know what a campaign manager does? Will you find love or heartbreak with your candidate? Leading the purrlitical revolution is up to you!

releases.name: The Slormancer
releases.summary:
The Slormancer is an epic 2D Action-RPG Dungeon Crawling game following a band of outcasts on their fight against hordes of enemies led by The Slormancer! Play as a "Mighty" Knight, a "Fierce" Huntress or a "Mischievous" Mage, master hundreds of abilities and ancestral powers, gear up, fight for the reputation of your kind and prove your value to the realm.

Featuring loads of shiny Loot, tons of collectibles, countless hours of content, a frenetic gameplay and carefully crafted pixel art.

releases.name: Let's Sing 2027
releases.summary:
Grab the mic - or your smartphone - and get ready to shine! The karaoke game Let's Sing 2027 transforms any occasion into a musical celebration with a brand-new playlist of chart-toppers and classics. Sing solo for high scores or team up with friends and family for unforgettable parties and performances.

Featuring songs with their original music videos, adjustable vocal guide settings, and easy-to-use smartphone and mic support, Let's Sing 2027 makes singing accessible, fun, and endlessly replayable. 

Whether you're hosting a party or chasing your best score, it's your turn to take center stage with the ultimate karaoke game!

releases.name: Mystery Detective Adventure 2
releases.summary: Other people’s secrets cannot escape the detective’s attention. “Mystery Detective Adventure 2” is an adventure game in the Hidden Objects genre, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters, and complicated quests.

releases.name: Mystery Suspect
releases.summary: Eighteen faces. A handful of questions. One mystery suspect.Study the lineup, choose a yes-or-no clue, and watch the possibilities narrow. Hair, glasses, hats and clothing details can all help you find the hidden person. Every question matters: use your clues carefully before you lock in your final guess.Meet a cast of 50 illustrated characters brought to life with animated portraits, recorded dialogue and character banter. Each new case draws a fresh lineup, giving you different details to notice and new combinations to untangle.Keep a campaign run alive across increasingly demanding cases. Earn points, build your streak, choose rewards and use bonus powers when the odds get tough. Three lives make every decision count, while saved progress lets you return to your case later.For a different challenge, play local versus on a shared board. Take turns asking questions and race another player to solve the mystery, or test your reasoning against a computer opponent.Settle in, get to know the suspects, and enjoy a cozy little mystery at your own pace. Subtitles, larger text and reduced-motion options help you get comfortable, and you can play offline whenever you're in the mood to crack a case.

releases.name: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls - Phoenix Cyclops
Ghost of Yotei: Echoes of Sekigahara
releases.summary: Ghost of Yōtei: Echoes of Sekigahara is a new narrative expansion. Split between the present day and flashbacks to Atsu’s time on the mainland, you’ll meet Nagato, a figure from Atsu’s past who has arrived in Ezo. In the present, you’ll explore a previously unseen valley once inhabited by The Snake and his gang of loyal followers, the Vipers. In the past, you’ll experience Atsu’s time in the Battle of Sekigahara and a key moment in her life before she returned home for her quest for vengeance. You’ll meet new enemies and find new heavy weapons, new armor sets, new dyes, and more. [PlayStation]

releases.name: Wreck the World
releases.summary: Every great demolition career starts small. Yours starts with a garden wall and your bare fists.Smash it, get paid, buy better tools, and work your way up: sheds, houses, office towers, whole city blocks, mountain ranges, entire continents... until there is only one job left. The world itself.WRECK THE WORLD is a comic-book demolition game where everything you hit cracks, crumbles and comes crashing down with real physics. Knock out the supports and watch a building topple. Bring down a tower and the rubble flattens everything below it.★ 16 DEMOLITION JOBSFrom the Wall to the World, each job is a new structure to bring down: shops, warehouses, a car park, a stadium, a whole city and more. Beat the clock, hit the target, cash out.★ 12 WEAPONS OF MASS DEMOLITIONFist. Hammer. Sledgehammer. Jackhammer. Wrecking ball. Dynamite. C4. Guided missiles. Bunker busters. Nukes. Orbital strikes. And, for the grand finale, an asteroid.★ UPGRADE EVERYTHINGEvery weapon has its own upgrade tree: more power, more reach, faster swings, critical hits. Hire drones, bulldozers and cranes to keep the destruction going while you aim for the big stuff.★ PRESTIGE AND PROMOTIONSCash in your progress for Blueprints and permanent boosts. Earn your way up five demolition licences, from Odd-Job to Planet Breaker. Each promotion unlocks tougher jobs and bigger paydays.★ CHAOS ON EVERY JOBRandom events can strike at any moment: lightning, earthquakes, a runaway truck, a meteor shower, a UFO beaming up your building, golden bricks, a fussy safety inspector and more.★ BONUS ROUNDS AND PUZZLESSurprise bonus missions full of sheep, dominoes, barrels and snowmen. Then test your brain in 20 demolition puzzles: limited TNT, one big DETONATE button, three stars to earn.★ A WORLD THAT FIGHTS BACK (A LITTLE)Smash the scenery. Bonk passing birds, pop hot-air balloons, scare the onlookers, honk the cars. Keep an eye on the sky for the odd giant monster, superhero or lost astronaut.★ COMIC-BOOK STYLEBold ink, halftone dots and BAM! POW! KA-BOOM! sound effects, with an original soundtrack and hundreds of crunchy, satisfying sounds.★ OVER 100 ACHIEVEMENTSSome you'll get in minutes. Some will take a true master of mayhem. A few are secret.And when the world is finally destroyed... well. Who said that was the end?Play at your own pace, completely offline, with no account needed. Your progress saves automatically.

releases.name: Phantom Floor
releases.summary: You are trapped on the Phantom Floor. You must find a way to escape, but keep quiet, it's always listening.

releases.name: BloodRayne: Definitive Collection
releases.summary:
The BloodRayne: Definitive Edition unites all three iconic entries in the series in one complete, enhanced collection, bringing the legendary dhampir back with updated visuals and modern improvements.

Become Rayne, a half-human, half-vampire agent working for the Brimstone Society, as she hunts supernatural threats across a dark and violent world. From battling occult forces tied to the Third Reich to confronting her own vampiric bloodline, Rayne’s journey spans brutal conflicts, relentless enemies, and deeply personal vendettas.

This collection includes the original BloodRayne, BloodRayne 2, and BloodRayne: Betrayal - Fresh Bites, combining fast-paced third-person action with stylish 2D hack-and-slash gameplay. Face hordes of soldiers, grotesque creatures, and powerful bosses using Rayne’s acrobatic combat skills, brutal melee attacks, and vampiric abilities.

releases.name: The Adventures Of Captain J
releases.summary: What do you get when you cross classic arcade action with a Dashing Space Hero? You get the newest release for the PS5, The Adventures Of Captain J! Guide the Captain through multiple levels of fast, hard-hitting action that will put your reflexes to the test! The fate of the universe is in your hands with the legend of the sky, Captain J!

releases.name: HorrorVale
releases.summary:
Welcome to HorrorVale! Your next door neighbors are zombies, reanimated monsters deliver the mail and ghosts hide out in your bathroom. Join Alice as she journeys through the underworld on a quest to save her zombie Dog, Scruffy from strange and unusual monsters that have suddenly invaded the once peaceful town of HorrorVale.

HorrorVale is a traditional RPG adventure game inspired by horror, full of unexpected twists and turns.

releases.name: VOiD:Reshaped
releases.summary: VOiD: Reshaped is a gravity-bending 2D puzzle platformer. Flip gravity to solve tricky puzzles, dodge deadly traps and survive enigmatic bosses as you guide a tiny cube through a relaxed yet challenging adventure for all ages.

releases.name: Innocent Memory
releases.summary:
The protagonist, Seiichi Makita, suddenly finds himself lost in an unknown world—a mysterious place free from all the injustices of ordinary life. Humans, animals, and plants alike are free to live as they wish in this seemingly ideal world.

Having lost most of his memories, Seiichi sets out in search of a way back to his own world alongside Yuki, a cat-eared girl he meets there. As their journey continues, fragments of his lost memories gradually begin to return. And beyond them lies a truth Seiichi could never have imagined...

releases.name: Lordcraft
releases.summary:
Lordcraft is a medieval fantasy kingdom-building RPG where you begin with a small settlement and grow it into a mighty realm. Gather resources, construct and upgrade buildings, expand your territory, and strengthen your castle.

Train settlers to become skilled warriors and build an army capable of defending your lands from orcs, skeletons, giants, dragons, and other dangerous enemies. Upgrade your heroes, craft powerful weapons and equipment, and shape the development of your kingdom as it grows.

Build your realm, lead your army into battle, conquer new lands, and become the most powerful lord in the kingdom!

releases.name: Pictaku: Halloween
releases.summary: Travel the world with the Yukimura family on a spooky Halloween adventure! Solve colorful nonograms to reveal hidden pictures, explore mysterious real-world locations, discover strange legends, and test your knowledge with themed quiz questions.Complete 120 main nonograms across 20 destinations, unlock bonus levels and additional puzzles, earn gold, upgrade useful power-ups, and fill the family’s souvenir room with mysterious collectibles from your journey. Choose from three difficulty modes and enjoy a colorful puzzle adventure filled with Halloween atmosphere and mysteries to uncover.

releases.name: Kitties Solitaire
releases.summary:
340 levels of cozy, cuddly card fun.

Curl up with the coziest card game on your console! Kitties Solitaire wraps the classic TriPeaks Solitaire experience in an adorable world of playful cats, warm colors, and charming feline companions.
Clear the peaks one card at a time in this relaxing yet endlessly engaging solitaire adventure. With 340 handcrafted levels, every session brings a fresh challenge — and a new reason to keep those paws tapping.
Features:

Full TriPeaks Solitaire — Master the beloved card system that's easy to learn and satisfying to perfect.
340 Levels — A massive collection designed to keep you playing for hours on end.
Unique Card Layouts — Varied and creative board designs ensure no two levels feel the same, delivering long-term engagement.
Smooth & Responsive — Enjoy fluid animations and tight controls that make every move feel great.
Undo & Rewards — Rethink your strategy with the handy undo system, and collect rewards as you climb each peak.

Whether you're a solitaire veteran or just love cute cats, Kitties Solitaire is the purr-fect way to unwind. Deal yourself in and let the good times paw-r in!

releases.name: Hidden Objects
releases.summary: Immerse yourself in the world of hidden object search! In this exciting game you will find many unique locations hand-drawn by the artist. The game will give you positive emotions.

releases.name: TIDEBREAK
releases.summary: Wake up on an island the sea swallows a little more every night. Punch trees, craft, build a camp, fish, and hold out against what crawls out of the water. Three bosses, a Beacon, one way home. Solo or with two friends.

releases.name: Quite My Tempo
releases.summary:
Quite My Tempo is an open and cross-platform sandbox for rhythm games in Virtual and Mixed Reality (VR/MR). It aims to provide a platform for immersive experiences rather than being a single game. A platform for music and rhythm-based mini-games, powered by content created by us, the community.

The game is highly customizable to cater to your preferences. This includes the ability to choose the type of gameplay, an environment in which the game takes place, custom models of weapons and destructible objects and more.

releases.name: Mercenary Corps
releases.summary: Play as Raptor, an experienced mercenary hired to dismantle a network of arms smugglers and terrorists. Infiltrate outposts, eliminate key targets and sabotage enemy facilities.Experience the full campaign solo or in co-op, then enter competitive PvP. Unlock weapons for PvP through a detailed progression system and track your performance with online statistics.- Full campaign playable solo or in co-op.- PvP combat across 9 maps and 2 game modes.- 16 unlockable weapons.- Detailed progression system.- Online player statistics.- Dedicated server support.

releases.name: Ultimate Wobble Run
releases.summary:
Ultimate Wobble Run is a chaotic physics-based party racing game where wobbly little runners sprint, jump, fall, stumble, recover, and compete all the way to the finish line.

In single-player, race against the clock, improve your best times, and try to reach the top of the leaderboards. Learn each level, master the movement, find better routes, and turn every messy run into a faster one.

In local multiplayer, up to 4 players can compete on the same couch in fast and hilarious races. Run for the checkered flag, survive chaotic hazards, escape rising lava, and challenge your friends in rounds where anything can happen.

Want to make things even more spicy? Jump into Party Mode, where players can place obstacles before the race begins. Protect your route, ruin someone else’s plan, and then race through the mess everyone helped create.

Easy to understand, funny to watch, and satisfying to master, Ultimate Wobble Run combines arcade racing, physics-based movement, player-placed obstacles, and party game chaos into quick, replayable challenges for solo players and groups of friends.

releases.name: Death Park
releases.summary: Can you solve all the puzzles and escape from the scary clown in this horror game? It is already waiting for you!

releases.name: Body Kounts
releases.summary:
Resurrect and Summon Extinct fantastical beasts to do battle on your behalf in this Arcadelike mind game of Life vs Death
Every defeat is fatal, you must use your wit and all the tools at your disposal to overcome challenges and survive.

releases.name: The Cat in the Hat: Rainy Day Mayhem
releases.summary: The Cat in the Hat once said, “It is fun to have fun, but you have to know how.” Everyone from the mischievous Dr. Seuss classic is here. Become smart and steady Sally, energetic wild card Johnny, cause double the trouble as Thing 1 and Thing 2 or be cheerful Little Cat A. And of course, the chaos conductor, The Cat in the Hat and anxiously wise Fish will be there to help, on this zany ride. Play solo or go against your friends, choosing from two trick-filled game modes. Fancy a game of chase? Then “Find the Cat” will have you turning the house upside down looking for The Cat in the Hat. Or maybe you prefer getting into chaotic challenges? See how quickly you can capture penguins, decorate a cake, and who knows what else in the 18 minigames you can choose from. But the fun doesn’t stop there, just like The Cat’s hat, it’ll be full of tricks. With varying difficulty levels, long challenges and short, there’s something for everyone. Get ready for your house to be filled with giggles, groans, and glorious mayhem.
